Native recursive precedence, original token identities, prefix-plus elision, whitespace skipping, first-error virtual boundary, expression/token recursion limits, forced recalc retention and subtotal-return meaning are preserved for supported tokens. The base error hook remains the actual native empty operation. Unsupported opcode families, existing array-context tokens and implicit-intersection/matrix modes reject explicitly before RPN mutation. No text scanner, function/reference-operator grammar, formula-cell evaluation/recalc, ODS, UI, full compiler constructor/services, or broad parity is claimed. Existing token-array limit bounds emitted scalar RPN; native overflow paths requiring expansions are outside this subset. Scope reduction is explicit and broad flags remain unverified.
